Before you subscribe

Frequently Asked Questions

A little clarity before you get behind the wheel.

Ask Our Team →
What is a car subscription?

A monthly vehicle plan with insurance, road tax and regular servicing included, for a selected subscription term. It gives you access to a car without purchasing it.

What documents do I need?

Have your NRIC/FIN or passport and valid driving licence ready. Our team will confirm eligibility, proof of residence and any other documents required for your application.

Is a deposit required?

A refundable deposit applies and varies by vehicle and plan. Your booking summary shows the deposit and first payment after approval. No car-purchase down payment does not mean no initial payment.

Can I drive into Malaysia?

Yes. Malaysia driving is included in all subscription prices, with no separate add-on fee. Before travelling, confirm the applicable coverage, excess, mileage allowance and travel requirements with our team.

Can I request a specific model or change my plan?

You can select a listed vehicle or ask about a preferred model, subject to availability. Extensions, swaps and early returns depend on your agreement and applicable conditions.

Do you accept corporate subscriptions?

Contact our team about business subscriptions, multiple vehicles, duration and billing requirements.
